title: Marjorie Taylor Greene: U.S. Congress Behind Closed Doors - Using Ukrainians to Weaken Russia
summary:
Marjorie Taylor Greene is an American Republican politician who served as a member of the U.S. House of Representatives representing Georgia from 2021 to 2026. She was a close partner of Trump during the election campaign in support of 'America First', and then became a leading critic of Trump after he betrayed America First.
